dataset.title: Acetyl-CoA availability regulates neuronal metabolism, growth, and synaptic activity

findings.message: The bundle holds 14535 where the producer reported 14536 (results.txt: All target PSMs with q-value <= 0.01 (pxreprise:DEF-PSM-1PCT v1)). Both numbers are kept; treat the producer's as canonical until the difference is explained.

12 of the 18 channels of the search's TmtDesign.txt have no row of the SDRF naming their file and label, so their assays sit on the design's own sample (its `Sample Name`), with nothing known about it. E.g. `PXD075949:250527_Neurons_TMT_master_AndersonRoz:TMT126`, `PXD075949:250527_Neurons_TMT_master_AndersonRoz:TMT127C`, `PXD075949:250527_Neurons_TMT_master_AndersonRoz:TMT127N` and 15 more.
The search identified an unusually small fraction of the MS2 spectra. Treat absence of a protein in this dataset as weak evidence. Producer's note: 14536/120934 = 12.02% of MS2 identified (S3)

The deposited SDRF describes its samples only as text with no ontology term, so the curated organism part, cell type, disease and individual columns are empty. The text is in sample_characteristics: cell type: neuron; organism part: brain. Match on it as text; it has not been mapped to a term.

Some modifications on peptides shared between proteins were not written to ptm_sites for one or more of those proteins, because the peptide could not be located in that protein's sequence and the producer's residue spans cannot be paired with its accessions. Of the (PSM, protein) pairs affected: 233 named a protein that does not contain the stored peptide -- typically a PSM ambiguous between peptide sequences (level 4 or 5), where this protein carries a different candidate than the first, which is the one stored. Sites on the other proteins of the same PSMs are written. Counts are in bundle.json under protein_databases.

12 channel(s) of the search's TmtDesign.txt are not study samples: `Sample Type` empty: `PXD075949:250527_Neurons_TMT_master_AndersonRoz:TMT128C`, `PXD075949:250527_Neurons_TMT_master_AndersonRoz:TMT129N`, `PXD075949:250527_Neurons_TMT_master_AndersonRoz:TMT130C`, `PXD075949:250527_Neurons_TMT_master_AndersonRoz:TMT131C`, `PXD075949:250527_Neurons_TMT_master_AndersonRoz:TMT131N` and 7 more. Their values measure that reference, not a sample of the question. The design is copied in `sources/`, and each assay keeps its `Sample Type` (`assays.design_sample_type`). A channel marked `empty` had no sample put in it: unless the SDRF names one for it, its assay has no `sample_id`, and its values are kept as measured (isotope spill-over from a neighbouring channel, PXReprise 098), so a count of samples never counts it and a median across a run's channels must leave it out.

PTM site occupancy was not stored: this is a TMT dataset, and MetaMorpheus computes intensity occupancy for label-free searches only; its count occupancy is per file, repeated on every channel (QuantProject DEF-OCC-INT). `ptm_stoichiometry` has no rows here because of that, not because no site was modified.

No per-run `metrics` row from results.txt for `psms_1pct` (1 of 1 runs), `peptides` (1 of 1 runs), `protein_groups` (1 of 1 runs), `precursors` (1 of 1 runs), `ms2_scans` (1 of 1 runs). These counts were not written, which is not a count of zero. MetaMorpheus writes results.txt's per-file lines only for a search of two or more files, and this deposit has one run, so its deposit-wide rows (`scope = 'dataset'`) count that run. Each run's MS2 spectra are also counted by the QC report, in `runs.ms2_spectra` and `metrics` (`name = 'ms2'`, `source = 'qc_report.json'`), for 1 of the 1 runs. PXReprise's QC payload counts each run's share of the whole search's 1% set instead, a different number (the FDR is the whole search's, not recomputed on each file), under names of its own (`source = 'qc_payload.json'`): `psms_1pct_whole_search` for 1 of the 1 runs, `peptides_1pct_whole_search` for 1 of the 1 runs, `protein_groups_1pct_whole_search` for 1 of the 1 runs.

dataset.summary: PXD075949 is a DDA isobaric dataset (Mus musculus) with 1 run, 6 samples and no enrichment step (whole proteome). It was reanalysed with MetaMorpheus 1.1.14. At 1% FDR the search reports 14,535 PSMs and 2,026 protein groups; 7,682 peptidoforms pass 1% on its q-value and notch q-value, and the repository holds 19,254 PTM sites for it. 6 open warnings about it are recorded.

organisms_are: `organisms` is the organism of the protein DATABASE the search used, not a statement about the samples. Sample annotation, where any exists, is in the catalog's `samples` and `sample_characteristics` tables.
